name: Usectl
description: Deploy and manage full-stack projects on usectl — a managed Kubernetes platform that turns a GitHub repo into a live HTTPS app with PostgreSQL, S3 storage, and automatic SSL. Includes deployment skill with full lifecycle knowledge, MCP server integration for direct API access, and slash commands (/deploy, /status, /logs) for quick operations. One prompt deploys your entire project.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, **3 commands** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (1): `usectl-deploy` (Deploy and manage full-stack projects on usectl — a managed Kubernetes platform that turns a GitHub repo into…)
- **Commands** (3): `deploy` (Deploy a project to usectl from a GitHub repo), `logs` (View deploy logs for a usectl project), `status` (Check status of a usectl project)
- **MCP servers** (1): `usectl`

Installs with `claude plugin install usectl@claude-community` from `syst3mctl/usectl-plugin`.
